description: Find every domain whose WHOIS record contains a given free-text search term (registrant name, email, organisation, address, etc.). Wildcards (`*`) and partial matches supported; multiple terms combine with AND. Use this when pivoting from a known registrant identity to other domains they own. Do NOT use this when you need a field-targeted query (use `reverse_whois_advanced`) or when you only have the domain (use `whois` / `whois_history`).

count_only.description: If true, returns only count (no credit usage). If false, returns domain list.

created_date_from.description: Search domains created after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

created_date_to.description: Search domains created before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

excluded_search_terms.description: Comma-separated search terms to exclude. Max 4 items. Case insensitive.

include_audit_dates.description: If true, includes domain list and last audit date.

included_search_terms.description: Comma-separated search terms to include (combined with AND logic). Max 4 items. Case insensitive.

punycode.description: If true, encodes domain names to Punycode.

search_after.description: Pagination needle from previous page's "nextPageSearchAfter" value.

search_type.description: Search type: "current" or "historic". "current" searches current records, "historic" searches all records.

updated_date_from.description: Search domains updated after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

updated_date_to.description: Search domains updated before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

name: reverse_whois
